svg.title: Initial endowment and the egalitarian equilibrium
svg.desc: Lecture-style comparison of omega=(4,2) and E=(3,1) in Alice’s coordinates. Short blue and red indifference-curve segments cross at omega and are tangent at E. The green gains-from-trade region reaches the right boundary; for these utilities there is no second intersection inside the box. E lies outside it. All indifference-curve strokes stop before the axes.
